title: run_answers
description: GET /runs/{id}/answers. Each resident's own answer for one run, so the map can colour every figure and a click on a person can show what they said. Written by infra/runs.get_answers from the stored resident responses; read by web/.

status.description: running or done; while running the list holds the answers stored so far

mode.description: fast = 25 residents share a model call; accurate = one resident per call

quote.description: one sentence, only for the sampled share of residents

distance_m.description: metres from the resident's home to the proposal's verified place; absent when the proposal has no verified place
